summary: The Telegram APK is the Android installer for Telegram, a cloud-based messaging app with large groups, channels, bots and optional end-to-end encrypted Secret Chats. Google Play updated it on November 21, 2026, and Telegram also offers its own official APK. It's free, with an optional Premium subscription.
metaDescription: Telegram APK download for Android: get the official Telegram from Google Play or telegram.org, with install steps, privacy settings and fixes.

faq.q: Where do I download the official Telegram APK?
faq.a: Install Telegram from Google Play (developer Telegram FZ-LLC), or download Telegram's own APK at telegram.org/android, which updates itself. Avoid copies on other APK sites.

Telegram is a legitimate app, but normal chats and groups are encrypted only between you and Telegram's servers. For end-to-end encryption, start a Secret Chat. Turn on two-step verification and limit who can see your phone number.

faq.q: Can I use Telegram without a phone number?
faq.a: You need a phone number to create an account, but you can hide it completely and let people find you by username. Telegram also accepts anonymous numbers sold on its Fragment platform.

faq.q: Why is Telegram asking for my email?
faq.a: Telegram may ask you to add a login email so it can send login codes by email instead of SMS. It's an optional, official feature inside the app.

faq.q: Telegram vs WhatsApp: what's the difference?
faq.a: WhatsApp encrypts every chat end to end and uses your contacts. Telegram stores chats in its cloud so they sync across devices, supports huge groups and channels, and only end-to-end encrypts Secret Chats.
